title: Remote Flux Refocuses Nonadiabatic Excursions in Compact-State Quantum Transfer
summary: Compact states embedded in a propagating band can carry quantum information, but finite-time transfer can populate modes outside their subspace. We show that a remote flux can refocus this amplitude without changing the transfer states or the motion-induced coupling out of their subspace. In a resonator ring, this separation is exact because both endpoints of the flux-bearing bond are nodes of every compact transfer state.
